text:
mira_sales: Quick sync 1 EnterpriseRetail POC wants commit guidance. Baseline traffic: 300 RPS embeddings overnight, daytime 600 RPS mixed (70% embeddings, 25% chat ~100 tokens, 5% batch rerank). They expect daily 10-15 minute spikes up to 2k RPS. They want reserved + autoscale + spot fallback. Thoughts?

devon_se: Need strict latency targets. They want chat p95 <= 300ms. Also require VPC + KMS.

sam_sre: Recommend reserved baseline sized for daytime steady load. For that mix 12 GPUs reserved gives good headroom. Spot ok for low-priority embeddings but not chat. Prewarm API needed for daily spikes.

leo_eng: Back-of-envelope: embeddings ~2000 qps/GPU, chat ~30-45 rps/GPU @100 tokens. 12 reserved -> ~24k embeddings or ~360-540 chat rps depending on batching. Spikes to 2k chat RPS need ~40-50 GPUs raw; with batching + prewarm we can reduce to ~14-18 GPUs. So suggest burst cap 18 with cross-AZ fallback.

ada_cs: Commercial: propose three offers: Basic 6 reserved (no guaranteed prewarm), Standard 12 reserved + burst to 18 (prewarm included), Premium 24 reserved multi-AZ. Burst billed at 1.8x reserved rate; prewarm windows included for Standard+.

infra-bot: Scheduled: prewarm smoke run on staging tomorrow 08:00 UTC. Results will be posted in #release-war-room.

mira_sales: Action items: (1) eng validate batching gains on sample prompts (leo) (2) SRE to draft VPC/KMS checklist and spot network constraints (sam) (3) commercial to prepare tier pricing and prewarm SLA (ada). We'll present Standard proposal after staging smoke. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
